The review found two items:

*   **[F1]** (fail, major, rule [R:TB-016]): The checked date and approved date were already filled at submission. Evidence shows `checked_date '01/10/2025'` and `approved_date '01/10/2025'` in zone A6 on Sheet 1.
*   **[F2]** (warning, major, rule [R:WPS-004]): An AI reviewer warning that the ⌀16 H7 bore [D12] has a tight tolerance of 0.018 mm, but the drawing does not specify if this size applies before or after the zinc plating noted in the title block [TB:surface_treatment]. Plating buildup could alter the fit; the reviewer suggests adding a note or providing an undersize allowance.
